verdict.rationale: The evidence says Customer Studio 'builds traits and audiences on top' of warehouse identity data, and that marketers build audiences in a no-code UI. That gives thin support for computed traits used in targeting. Nothing shows predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity; AI Decisioning picks message, channel and timing, not profile-level scores. Missing for 10: documented predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, detail on how computed traits are defined and kept up to date, evidence of traits being used as audience filters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
